static_objects.name: Liver_HepaticSupport
static_objects.description: Fixed organ support with a continuous refined hepatic bed; contact mesh is this same geometry.

static_objects.name: LocalPeritonealCavity
static_objects.description: Open local cavity reference surface; its camera-side boundary is intentional.

static_objects.name: InferiorCavitySurface
static_objects.description: Lower local cavity background, outside tested manipulation envelope.

static_objects.name: AnteriorOmentalFold
static_objects.description: Original lobulated local fat/omentum sheet; intentional thin-sheet boundary.

static_objects.name: LateralOmentalFold
static_objects.description: Continuous surrounding omental skirt outside the active gallbladder wall.

static_objects.name: CysticDuctLandmark
static_objects.description: Anatomical orientation landmark; no duct cutting or fluid simulation.

static_objects.name: CysticArteryLandmark
static_objects.description: Provisional arterial landmark pending anatomical review.

dynamic_surface.name: Gallbladder_Wall_Outer
dynamic_surface.binding: outer physical layer of matching material vertex; no independent render displacement

attachment_bridge.binding: Each boundary edge joins current OUTER wall material vertices to its two fixed anchor positions on the actual hepatic collision triangles.

appearance_notes: No lighting/highlights baked into base color.
Normal maps describe shading detail, not geometry truth.
Blender preview subdivision is editable; UE runtime must use its recorded physical binding.

orientation.x: lateral (simulation axis, not a patient DICOM axis)
orientation.y: fundus to neck; tools enter from negative Y
orientation.scope: local gallbladder working field; not a complete abdomen
